feeds.title: Corn, Beans, Pigs & Kids
feeds.description: I am proud to be a farmer, farmer's wife and stay at home mom. Combine that passion with my love for my community and volunteering, there always seems to be 'fields of opportunities' for me and my family in rural North Iowa. Follow along my journey.

feeds.title: The Frugal Farm Wife
feeds.description: Articles on gluten-free recipes, frugal living tips and simple diy by Elise New. The frugal farm wife is where she shares adventures in saving money, making money, allergy-free eating, and living healthy.

feeds.title: Brown Family Farm Blog
feeds.description: Weekly updates from our farm, recipes and what's coming up in your next CSA. We are a husband and wife run CSA Share farm, established in 2012 by Owner Ben Brown. We come from humble beginnings, starting our farm on just a few of acres of family land with a handful of seeds.

feeds.title: Kim's County Line
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kim Fritzemeier, Kansas farm wife who blogs at Kim's County Line about farm, family, faith, food & photography. Loves all of the above, along with reading and music.

feeds.title: A Farm Wife
feeds.description: A blog on family, farm & fun with really good grub by Diane Reed Loew. After successfully raising four somewhat normal sons, and being married to the same wonderful farmer for over 45 years, Diane felt a duty to give back to motherhood and life in general. Thus, the random ramblings of A Farm Wife.

feeds.title: Buzzard's Beat
feeds.description: A blog about life on a Kansas ranch, the life of a cowgirl, Cooking, moving cattle, and going down the rodeo trail or running by Buzzard. The husband and wife operate a small ranch in southeast Kansas where they spend a large chunk of time rodeoing, running, and engaging in a rural community.

feeds.title: Farmer's Wife and Mummy
feeds.description: Articles by Emma on farm life, kids and animals. Emma, is a farmer's wife and a mummy to our three children. She have been a journalist for over ten years and is determined to write a novel one day.

feeds.title: Minnesota Farm Living Blog
feeds.description: Articles on agriculture, rural leaving and travel by Wanda Patsche at Minnesota Farm Living. Wanda lives in southern Minnesota, she is a city girl turned in farm wife. She is passionate about agriculture and loves to discuss today's agriculture issues and modern ag life.

feeds.title: Just another Day on the Farm
feeds.description: Welcome to my blog, I share a little about everything large gardens, milking sheep, recipes, and permaculture. I am Canadian, 4th gen born in my family in Alberta. I grew up in a farming family with horses, hounds, hunting, and fishing following a pipeline father and a very strong mother who could make us a home.

feeds.title: Modern Farm Wife
feeds.description: Articles by Jessica on learning to live the life of a modern farm wife.Jessica traded stilettos for rubber boots to marry a dairy man. Ten years, one border collie, hundreds of cows, and three kids later, she is still learning to be a farmers wife.

feeds.title: Prairie Californian
feeds.description: A blog on cultivating a legacy of family, food, photography and farming on the rural prairies of North Dakota by Jenny Dewey Rohrich. Jenny is a daughter of a second generation butcher and wife to a born and raised North Dakota farmer.

feeds.title: In Between the Sunsets of Life
feeds.description: A blog on life of a farm wife by Julie. She has been blogging since 2012 and periodically take breaks, all while raising one last daughter and working part time at farm. She loves taking photos of her family and country life on the farm.

feeds.title: This Farm Wife Blog
feeds.description: Read life stories and articles by Meredith Bernard a perfectly imperfect farm wife who loves chasing cows, kids and God-sized dreams. Meredith quit her corporate sales job in 2013 to come home to the farm, she traded her truck for a tractor, while also finding a passion for photography and writing.
